top_findings.title: No MCP server — the central deliverable is stubbed as an interactive CLI
top_findings.evidence: main.go:77-79 Listen() comment 'In a real implementation, this would start listening for MCP requests. For now, we'll provide a simple CLI interface for testing' then calls s.runCLI(); Request/Response/Error/Notification structs (main.go:19-44) are declared but never instantiated (grep for 'Request{|Response{|Notification{|RegisterTool|jsonrpc|tools/list|tools/call' across *.go returns nothing); no os.Stdin/bufio/json.Decode JSON-RPC loop exists
top_findings.suggestion: Implement a real MCP server: a JSON-RPC stdio loop that handles initialize/tools/list/tools/call and registers the query functions as MCP tools

top_findings.title: No head-to-head record between two named teams
top_findings.evidence: data.go exposes FindMatchesByTeam(one team, data.go:498) and GetTeamStats(one team, data.go:533) only; no function takes two team names and returns H2H W/L/D. Spec asks for it explicitly (TASK.md:189 'Compare Palmeiras and Santos head-to-head', TASK.md:253 'Head-to-head records', TASK.md:334 'Can compare teams head-to-head', example output TASK.md:175). grep for 'HeadToHead|H2H|Versus' across *.go returns nothing
top_findings.suggestion: Add a function taking two team names, filter matches where both appear, and tally W/L/D from each side's perspective
